dataset: Original frozen Hotpot50, all 50 same input token arrays
prefill: Full attention on complete frozen prompt, shared first token
ranker: Frozen original ranker; stable descending rank order
teacher: FP32 full QK softmax per current generated state; mean of 4 Q heads per KV head

arms.oracle_exact: Smallest integer count along frozen ranking satisfying target
arms.oracle_bucket: Smallest original bucket >= exact count; [0,4,8,16,32,64,128,256,ALL], clipped to candidate count

scope: Independent end-to-end generation for both arms plus same-state counterfactual costs; no learned budget calls, training, new data, or recalibration
verification: Budget boundaries, minimality, coverage, fixed-input hashes, shared full first tokens, teacher-free selection-plan replay on first and last four documents
costs: Per-question means and total token slots including fixed sink/local/current tokens; padding is max over 8 KV heads per layer. Oracle wall-clock not a deployable latency estimate.
